name: ts
notes: The fifth arm's arg list named packages/coding-agent/test/agent-plugins.test.ts, which does not exist at fulton/rebase-v18.20.0@0052ebcae1: the suite is packages/coding-agent/test/discovery/agent-plugins.test.ts, and it is already executed by the packages/coding-agent/test/discovery directory argument. Dropped rather than re-pointed, because the explicit path adds no coverage over the directory argument while reading as a separately-covered suite. An earlier version of this note claimed re-pointing would run the same file twice under two arguments; that was wrong and is corrected here -- measured at this base, `bun test packages/coding-agent/test/discovery` and `bun test packages/coding-agent/test/discovery packages/coding-agent/test/discovery/agent-plugins.test.ts` both report `Ran 272 tests across 32 files`, so Bun's positional filters deduplicate instead of executing the suite twice. The battery has been certified verdict=pass at this base with the dead entry present, which is the measurement that shows `bun test` does not fail on a path argument matching nothing -- the entry was costing nothing and proving nothing, while reading as coverage. Re-verified before removal: git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- packages/coding-agent/test lists agent-plugins only under discovery/, and all 18 remaining arguments in this arm were each checked to name an existing file or directory.

Fifth arm added 2026-11-16: packages/coding-agent's discovery + memory-backend suites, measured 493 pass / 0 fail in 4.8s at fulton/rebase-v18.20.0@616a1c9d14, invoked from the worktree root exactly as the gate invokes it. It exists because every remaining concept in this farm edits packages/coding-agent (nested skill discovery, the native memvidkb MemoryBackend, parity tools, injection parity, disable-legacy) and the utils/tavily arm never executes that package -- so without this arm a verdict=pass says nothing at all about the code under change. It is a TARGETED suite in the shape of the utils/tavily arm, NOT test:ts: the full suite stays out for the flakiness recorded below, and the rule that an arm which cannot exit 0 at base carries no signal is what both arms obey.

check:ts = oxlint + oxfmt --check + per-package tsc; test:ts = ci-test-ts local-ts; ci:test:smoke = CLI --version/--help/stats --help/--smoke-test; gen:bundle = bun --cwd=packages/coding-agent run gen:bundle.
gen:bundle is the only arm that catches a missing barrel export; keep it.
Order is deliberate: the battery stops at the first failing command, so the deterministic arms run before the targeted test arm.

`bun run test:ts` was REMOVED from this battery on 2026-11-15 by measurement, not preference. Two gate runs on this machine: concept tavily-dirs-helper @9028ca57cc gave 232 chunks pass / 8 fail over 240 commands (1121 test files); baseline-fork @d072a87aed gave 221 / 18 over 239 (1120 files), the extra failures being test/tools/browser-*.test.ts Chromium/WebKit-host flakes that pass or fail run to run. An arm that cannot exit 0 at the base makes every verdict `fail` and so carries no signal, because verdict=pass requires every arm to exit 0.

test:ts is still run by the ORCHESTRATOR at integration only, judged by the failing FILE SET: a failing file inside a package the concept touched is a regression, count drift elsewhere is noise. Never compare totals across runs — the chunk count itself moves (239 vs 240) with file discovery.

Stable pre-existing failures at this base, for that comparison: packages/tui/test/glyph-protocol.test.ts (6), packages/tui/test/terminal-appearance.test.ts (1, #15596), packages/coding-agent/test/export-html-template.test.ts (1), packages/coding-agent/test/telemetry-export.test.ts (4), packages/coding-agent/test/usage-cli-extension-usage.test.ts (1), packages/coding-agent/test/stream/redactor.test.ts (1). Flaky/timing, count varies: test/lsp/watched-files.test.ts, test/cli-responses-websocket-recovery.test.ts, all test/tools/browser-*.test.ts.

The targeted arm covers packages/utils + packages/tavily because those are the packages this farm's concepts actually change; it is deterministic (~10s, 1002 pass / 24 skip measured at 9028ca57cc) where test:ts is not. A concept changing other packages must report its own per-package `bun test <pkg>` run with per-file counts and mutation probes in addition to the gate.

build:native must have run in the primary checkout first; each worktree also needs packages/natives/native/pi_natives.darwin-arm64.node symlinked from the primary, because the loader resolves the addon relative to its own directory and the .node is gitignored.

nodeModules stays symlink-if-lock-matches because pi_natives.darwin-arm64.node is a gitignored, primary-only build output. Consequence: workspace self-imports resolve into the primary, so each worktree needs the packages/node_modules/@oh-my-pi overlay (see farm notes) or the battery tests the wrong sources.
